ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2_70.note: the incumbent v16 recipe; must reproduce the baseline exactly (ratio 1.0); cannot qualify

ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2_80.note: the incumbent committee at blend weight 0.8 (weight alone)

development_baseline.name: v16 development predictions
development_baseline.recipe: v9 + 1.0 * v12 development residual on matched rows outside LIRF, then (1 - 0.7) * that + 0.7 * ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2 (out-of-sample per fold) on every row outside LIRF, floored; reproduces 330.469 / 271.782 / 192.417 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025 (runs/adsb_v17_sel/selection.json, ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2_70)

configuration.development_scheme: leave-one-month-out over the three scoring months that hold out-of-sample v9 predictions (Jan and Jul 2025 from the seasonal fold, Nov 2025 from the forward fold); for each variant (scope, feature set) the residual model is fitted on the other two months' in-scope rows and applied to the held-out month's in-scope rows; every other row keeps v9

ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2.rule: as declared in configs/adsb_v17_v1.json (one third of the LightGBM group mean ens_v15_lgb, two thirds of the combination-CatBoost group mean ens_v17_ctr; runs/adsb_v17/ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2, hash-bound below); the v16 committee and the baseline here

ens_v17_bag_ctr_q.rule: one quarter of the LightGBM group mean plus three quarters of the five-member combination group mean (re-weighting of the incumbent committee, no new learner)

ens_v18_bag_c2.rule: one third of the LightGBM group mean plus two thirds of ens_v18_ctr

ens_v18_bag_q.rule: one quarter of the LightGBM group mean plus three quarters of ens_v18_ctr

ens_v18_ctr.rule: mean of finite predictions (the five combination CatBoosts of ens_v17_ctr and the four new ones)

ensembles.missing_members: if a learner variant fails to complete on all three folds it is dropped from every ensemble that lists it and the drop is recorded in the selection; no other change
ensembles.tool: tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py (per-row mean of finite member predictions, fold by fold); nested means are built by listing members with multiplicities that reproduce the weighted group means exactly (ens_v17_bag_ctr_q: each LightGBM five times and each of the five combination CatBoosts eighteen times, 120 entries; ens_v18_bag_c2: each LightGBM three times and each of the nine combination CatBoosts four times, 54 entries; ens_v18_bag_q: each LightGBM once and each of the nine combination CatBoosts twice, 24 entries); every learner predicts every non-LIRF row

execution.learner_fits_on_workers: tools/launch_adsb_learners.py --config configs/adsb_v18_v1.json (16 threads per fit, one variant per worker, folds in sequence)

external_data.extraction: tools/adsb_extract_day.py keeps positions inside the ten aerodrome boxes that are on the ground or below 3,000 ft; per-day parquet with archive part hashes under data/external/adsblol/surface/ (the tool now skips and counts a corrupt archive member instead of aborting the day; the surface files used here predate that change and are unaffected)
external_data.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; feeder data CC0; licence files are inside every archive
external_data.matching: tools/build_adsb_features.py: ICAO callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else FLIGHT_mvt) and takeoff within the track's ground-to-air transition; stand positions learned label-free from covered segments of Jan/Mar/Apr/Jul/Nov 2025 (1,111 stands); the pass-2 matches and stands are exactly the v11 inputs, snapshotted under data/external/adsblol/matches_v11/ and hash-bound below
external_data.source: adsb.lol globe_history daily archives (GitHub releases adsblol/globe_history_2025 and globe_history_2026, tags vYYYY.MM.DD-planes-readsb-prod-0)

configuration.floor_seconds_rule: minimum departure label over the refit months (-12), applied after the residual

incumbent.official_rank: not recorded (the user's standing rule: no leaderboard checks)
incumbent.recipe: v16 = (1 - 0.7) * (v9 + 1.0 * v12 ADS-B residual on matched rows outside LIRF) + 0.7 * ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2 (one third of the six-LightGBM group mean, two thirds of the five combination-CatBoost group mean, all without LIRF) on every row outside LIRF, floored (configs/adsb_v17_v1.json, ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2_70; uploaded 18:03 UTC 16 September 2026)

learner_common.catboost_base: configs/timeline_v1.json catboost block (depth 8, learning rate 0.055, l2 10, Bernoulli 0.8, rsm 0.9, max_ctr_complexity 1, one_hot_max_size 10, early stopping 200) with the overrides above and a 20,000-round cap
learner_common.features: timeline bundle CORE + FLOWN + SURFACE (276) + 27 ADS-B features from data/external/adsblol/matches (matches2_*, stands.parquet: exactly the tables the v14 learners used; hashes recorded in every run record)
learner_common.folds: seasonal and forward (out-of-sample fold predictions), refit on the eleven 2025 months at the median best iteration
learner_common.settings: configs/timeline_v1.json (lightgbm / catboost blocks; parameter overrides above)

learner_code_run_adsb_learner.note: the runner as amended in v16 (matched-row RMSE None when no finite prediction); snapshot docs/adsb_v17/run_adsb_learner_declared.py

configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after adsb_v17 (docs/adsb_v17/README.md): four combination CatBoosts and the one-third / two-thirds bag moved the development mean ratio to v15 to 0.99725 and the export scored 241.75 officially (v15 242.5783). Learner-level RMSE on the non-LIRF rows (seasonal / forward): the combination group of five 267.74 / 158.45, ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2 267.35 / 157.33; a descriptive scan of the LightGBM share a on the recorded tables gives 267.26 / 157.46 at a = 0.2, 267.26 / 157.36 at 0.25, 267.35 / 157.33 at 1/3 and 267.74 / 158.45 at 0 (no LightGBM), so the share is near its optimum and the remaining lever is more combination members: each of v17's plain seeds was worth roughly 0.1 percentage points of the mean ratio. The four learners here are two more seeds of the cat_ctr2 recipe and two more of cat_ctr3 (the depth-10 and one-hot variants of v17 were not better than a plain seed and are not repeated). No learner listed here had been fitted before this declaration.

residual_model.applies_to: the residual model is exactly v12's (nb feature set, matched rows outside LIRF, weight 1.0); each candidate then blends the result with a declared ensemble, value = (1 - w) * (v9 + residual) + w * ensemble, on every row outside LIRF; rows outside both scopes keep v9 exactly.
residual_model.blend: post-hoc convex combination with the extra table adsb_full (candidate_values in tools/run_adsb_v11.py); a NaN learner value leaves the row unblended
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and variant (scope, feature set) come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, at most 4000); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: median of the selected variant's three development round counts

scopes.all_no_lirf: every departure at any airport except LIRF: a blend scope only (unmatched rows there become (1 - w) * v9 + w * adsb_full)
scopes.matched_no_lirf: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment at any airport except LIRF (adsb_matched == 1 and airport != LIRF): the residual model's training and prediction scope (exactly v12)

configuration.selection: For each candidate (ensemble, blend weight w), RMSE of the blended prediction on each held-out month versus the v16 development prediction (the incumbent's recipe on the same rows: all departures of the month). A candidate is eligible when it is not worse than v16 on ANY month (ratio <= 1.0) and its mean ratio over the three months is at most 0.9985 (a 0.15% mean improvement over the incumbent, the v17 bar). Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio to v16; otherwise select nothing. Set before any v18 learner is fitted. The pure re-weighting candidates (ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2_80, ens_v17_bag_ctr_q_70/80) are expected to fall short of the bar on their own (a descriptive scan of the recorded tables puts the LightGBM share of one quarter within 0.1 s of one third at the learner level); they are included so that the weight and share are chosen by the rule rather than by hand, and so that the new seeds' contribution can be read against them. The ens_v17_bag_ctr_c2_70 candidate reproduces the incumbent and is a check, not a candidate that can qualify. Ratios to v9, per-airport tables and the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference to v16 are descriptive only.
